verdict.rationale: PostHog exposes SQL, a public API, and a CLI that could be scripted for bulk data queries/modifications (posthog-docs-8, posthog-docs-11, posthog-docs-20), and MCP/AI agents can run HogQL queries or manage flags via prompts (posthog-docs-19, posthog-docs-24). However, there's no explicit feature for bulk operations across many items (e.g., batch editing flags, dashboards, or events), and a community report notes the AI/LLM integration struggling with even single query tasks (posthog-comm-8), suggesting automation depth for bulk actions is unproven.
